capabilities.label: CAPABILITIES
capabilities.title: What Emmi can do
capabilities.item1: Speaks your customers' language — flawless Romanian and Russian on the phone; in chat it also replies in English and Ukrainian.
capabilities.item2: Reasons before it answers — understands what's actually being asked, even when the question is vague or spread across several messages.
capabilities.item3: Hears you perfectly — understands speech in under half a second, with no awkward silence.
capabilities.item4: Pronounces everything right — company names, phone numbers and abbreviations, spoken clearly every time.
capabilities.item5: See everything at a glance — what customers ask, on which channels, in which languages, live in your dashboard.
capabilities.item6: Turns conversations into leads — captures the contact and what they need, ready for your team or your CRM.
capabilities.item7: A summary every Monday — what happened, what was asked most, what needs your attention.

speed.title: Answers in Under a Second
speed.text: At the speed of a real conversation. The caller never waits in silence, and the chat never leaves anyone staring at a blank screen.

voice.title: A Voice That Sounds Human
voice.text: Warm and natural in Romanian and Russian, hard to tell from a real person — and it says company names, phone numbers and abbreviations correctly, every time.

documents.title: Only From Your Documents
documents.text: Every answer is grounded in what you uploaded. When the answer is not there, Emmi says so and hands the conversation to your team instead of inventing one.

connections.title: Official Channel Connections
connections.text: Phone, website, Instagram, WhatsApp and Telegram are connected through each platform's own approved route — no workarounds that stop working overnight.

memory.title: Smart Memory
memory.text: Your documents become Emmi's memory — it finds the right information instantly, in either language.

hosting.title: Solid Foundation
